page.title: 進行形は動く場面を映す

analysis.summaryJa: 進行形be + -ingは、主語を進行中・一時的な活動の中に置いて動く場面として描く。beが時制・疑問・否定を担当し、-ingが活動そのものを示す。現在形の習慣・安定状況と、進行形の一時的・進行中の状況を区別する。
grammarPoints: beが主語に一致し時制を担う
疑問文ではbeを主語の前へ出す
否定文ではbeの後ろにnotを置く
一時的な状況は進行形、安定した習慣や状態は現在形で表す
visualEvidence: 静止画と動画の対比が現在形と進行形の見え方を示している
BEの操作盤が時制・疑問・否定を担う構造を示している
短い一時期間と広い習慣リングが意味の時間幅を対比している
commonTraps: beを落として-ingだけにする
疑問文でdoを使ってしまう
一時的なthis weekを単純現在で表す
恒常的な習慣を不必要に進行形にする

questions.prompt: The maintenance crew ------- the lobby lights right now.

choices.B: replace

questions.translationJa: 保守チームは今、ロビーの照明を交換しています。
questions.explanationJa: right nowは進行中の一時的動作を示すためis replacingを使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Reed ------- at the Osaka branch this month while her office is renovated.

choices.B: worked every month

questions.translationJa: リードさんはオフィス改装中の今月、大阪支店で勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: this monthだけの一時的な勤務なので現在進行形is workingが適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- the guests still waiting in the conference area?

choices.B: Have

questions.translationJa: 来客はまだ会議エリアで待っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形の疑問文はbeを主語の前へ出すためAreが正解です。

questions.prompt: The technicians ------- the server now because the update failed.

choices.B: are restarting

questions.translationJa: 更新に失敗したため、技術者たちは今サーバーを再起動しています。
questions.explanationJa: nowの進行中の動作なのでare restartingを使います。

questions.prompt: Our team usually works in Tokyo, but this week we ------- from Nagoya.

choices.B: work

questions.translationJa: 私たちのチームは普段東京で働きますが、今週は名古屋から勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: usuallyの習慣とthis weekの一時状況を対比しているためare workingです。
questions.focus: 現在形と進行形の対比

questions.prompt: The courier ------- for a signature at reception at the moment.

choices.B: wait

questions.translationJa: 配達員は現在、受付で署名を待っています。
questions.explanationJa: at the momentは現在進行形の明確な手掛かりです。

questions.prompt: Why ------- you checking the same invoice again?

choices.B: are

questions.translationJa: なぜ同じ請求書をもう一度確認しているのですか。
questions.explanationJa: youに対応するbeはareで、進行形疑問文はare you checkingとなります。
questions.focus: 進行形の疑問語疑問文

questions.prompt: The reception desk ------- phone calls at this exact moment because the lines are down.

choices.B: does not taking

questions.translationJa: 回線障害のため、受付は今この瞬間電話を受けていません。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形の否定はbe + not + -ingなのでis not takingです。

questions.prompt: Mr. Park ------- near the airport; it is his permanent residence.

choices.B: is living this week

questions.translationJa: パークさんは空港近くに住んでいます。そこが恒久的な住居です。
questions.explanationJa: permanent residenceという安定した生活状況なので現在形livesが自然です。

questions.prompt: The project team ------- in a temporary office until the renovation ends.

choices.B: is working

questions.translationJa: プロジェクトチームは改装終了まで仮設オフィスで勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: until the renovation endsで一時的状況だと分かるためis workingが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for an action happening now.

choices.A: The engineers do testing the new sensor now.
choices.B: The engineers testing the new sensor now.
choices.C: The engineers is testing the new sensor now.
choices.D: The engineers are testing the new sensor now.

questions.translationJa: 技術者たちは今、新しいセンサーをテストしています。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語engineersにはareを使い、are testingで現在進行形を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct progressive question.

choices.A: Do they waiting for the shuttle?
choices.B: Are they waiting for the shuttle?
choices.C: They are waiting for the shuttle?
choices.D: Is they waiting for the shuttle?

questions.translationJa: 彼らはシャトルを待っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形疑問文はAre + subject + -ingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a temporary arrangement.

choices.A: I work at the Kyoto branch this week only.
choices.B: I am work at the Kyoto branch this week.
choices.C: I am working at the Kyoto branch this week.
choices.D: I working at the Kyoto branch this week.

questions.translationJa: 今週は京都支店で働いています。
questions.explanationJa: this weekという一時的な期間なのでam workingが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative progressive sentence.

choices.A: The printer is not working now.
choices.B: The printer does not working now.
choices.C: The printer not is working now.
choices.D: The printer is not work now.

questions.translationJa: プリンターは今動いていません。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形の否定はis not workingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a stable living situation.

choices.B: Ms. Lee is living near headquarters permanently every year.

questions.translationJa: リーさんは本社近くに住んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: 安定した居住状況は通常現在形livesで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence correctly contrasting routine and temporary work.

choices.A: He usually work in sales, but this month he assisting marketing.
choices.B: He usually is working in sales, but this month he assists marketing.
choices.C: He usually works in sales, but this month he is assisting marketing.
choices.D: He usually worked in sales every day, but this month he is assist marketing.

questions.translationJa: 彼は普段営業ですが、今月はマーケティングを手伝っています。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の役割は現在形、一時的な今月の活動は進行形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an ongoing repair.

choices.A: The contractor repairs the roof right this minute.
choices.B: The contractor is repairing the roof right this minute.
choices.C: The contractor is repair the roof right this minute.
choices.D: The contractor repairing the roof right this minute.

questions.translationJa: 業者は今この瞬間、屋根を修理しています。
questions.explanationJa: right this minuteは進行中を示すためis repairingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct progressive negative for a plural subject.

choices.A: The guests not waiting outside now.
choices.B: The guests doesn't waiting outside now.
choices.C: The guests isn't waiting outside now.
choices.D: The guests aren't waiting outside now.

questions.translationJa: 来客は今、外では待っていません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語にはare not/aren't + waitingを使います。
questions.focus: 複数主語の進行形否定

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence for a temporary stay.

choices.A: I stay at the airport hotel this week while my apartment is repaired.
choices.B: I am stay at the airport hotel this week.
choices.C: I am staying at the airport hotel this week while my apartment is repaired.
choices.D: I staying at the airport hotel this week.

questions.translationJa: 自宅の修理中なので、今週は空港ホテルに滞在しています。
questions.explanationJa: this week while...という一時滞在なのでam stayingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct statement about present progressive form.

choices.A: BE carries tense and moves in questions, while -ing shows the activity.
choices.B: The -ing form alone carries tense and questions.
choices.C: Do is always required before every progressive question.
choices.D: Progressive form always means a permanent habit.

questions.translationJa: beが時制を担い疑問文で移動し、-ingが活動を示します。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形の構造上の役割分担を正しく説明しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The staff are preparing the hall now.”

choices.A: The preparation is in progress at this moment.
choices.B: Preparing the hall is only their yearly routine.
choices.C: They prepared the hall last year only.
choices.D: They will never prepare the hall.

questions.translationJa: ホールの準備が今この瞬間進行中です。
questions.explanationJa: are preparing nowは現在進行中の動作です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I’m working from home this week.”

choices.A: I will begin work at some unknown future time.
choices.B: Working from home is necessarily a permanent lifelong habit.
choices.C: I worked from home only last year.
choices.D: Working from home is presented as a temporary situation this week.

questions.translationJa: 在宅勤務は今週だけの一時的状況として示されています。
questions.explanationJa: this week＋進行形は期間限定の一時性を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Are they still waiting?”

choices.A: The speaker reports a finished wait last year.
choices.B: The speaker asks about a permanent job title.
choices.C: The speaker asks whether the waiting is continuing now.
choices.D: The speaker predicts a wait next month.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は待つ動作が今も続いているか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: still＋進行形疑問文は継続中かどうかを確認します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “They aren't using the main entrance now.”

choices.A: The main entrance is permanently forbidden forever.
choices.B: At present, their use of the main entrance is not in progress.
choices.D: They always use it as a routine.

questions.translationJa: 現在、彼らは正面入口を使用していません。
questions.explanationJa: aren't using nowは現在の一時的な非進行状態を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She lives near the station.”

choices.A: Her residence near the station is presented as a stable situation.
choices.B: She is necessarily moving houses this week.
choices.D: She is temporarily visiting the station right now.

questions.translationJa: 駅近くに住むことが安定した居住状況として示されています。
questions.explanationJa: 単純現在livesは安定した生活状況を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The engineers are testing a prototype this afternoon.”

choices.B: Testing prototypes is their permanent identity only.
choices.C: Testing is a temporary activity scheduled/in progress within this afternoon.

questions.translationJa: 試作品のテストは今日午後という限定期間の一時的活動です。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形は時間幅のある一時活動を描きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Is the printer working?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who owns the printer.
choices.B: The speaker asks what the printer did last year.
choices.C: The speaker states the printer always works permanently.
choices.D: The speaker asks whether the printer is functioning now.

questions.translationJa: プリンターが今作動しているか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: Is...working?は現時点の作動状況を問います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This month, the sales team is using a temporary office.”

choices.A: The temporary office use is limited to the current month.
choices.B: The sales team always uses that office permanently.
choices.C: The office was used only in 2010.
choices.D: The office will never be used.

questions.translationJa: 仮設オフィスの利用は今月に限定されています。
questions.explanationJa: this month＋進行形は一時的状況を強く示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “BE is the control part of the progressive.”

choices.A: The -ing form alone changes for every subject.
choices.B: BE carries agreement, tense, question movement, and negation.
choices.C: Do replaces BE in every progressive sentence.
choices.D: BE is optional in standard progressive clauses.

questions.translationJa: beが主語との一致、時制、疑問文での移動、否定を担当します。
questions.explanationJa: 進行形ではbeが文法的な操作を担います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Simple present and progressive differ in viewpoint.”

choices.A: Progressive can only refer to the distant past.
choices.B: They always mean exactly the same thing.
choices.C: Simple present often gives a stable/habitual view; progressive gives a moving temporary view.
choices.D: Simple present can never describe routines.

questions.translationJa: 現在形は安定・習慣的な見方、進行形は動く一時的な見方を示すことが多いです。
questions.explanationJa: ページの中心対比を正しくまとめています。
questions.focus: 現在形と進行形の視点差

questions.prompt: The meeting begins in ten minutes. The staff ------- chairs in the hall right now.

choices.B: are arranging

questions.translationJa: 会議は10分後に始まります。スタッフは今ホールで椅子を並べています。
questions.explanationJa: right nowの進行中動作なのでare arrangingです。

questions.prompt: Mr. Tanaka normally works in Nagoya. This week, however, he ------- at headquarters.

choices.B: works permanently

questions.translationJa: 田中さんは普段名古屋勤務です。しかし今週は本社で勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: normallyとthis weekの対比から一時的なis workingが適切です。

questions.prompt: The phone lines are busy. “------- the support agents still speaking with customers?”

choices.B: Is

questions.translationJa: 電話回線が混雑しています。『サポート担当者はまだ顧客と話していますか』。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語agentsの進行形疑問文はAre they speakingです。

questions.prompt: The machine is temporarily offline. It ------- orders while the technician installs new software.

choices.B: does not processing

questions.translationJa: 機械は一時停止中です。技術者が新ソフトを導入している間、注文を処理していません。
questions.explanationJa: 一時的な非進行状況なのでis not processingです。

questions.prompt: Our headquarters is in Tokyo, but during renovations the executive team ------- from a nearby hotel.

choices.B: has working

questions.translationJa: 本社は東京ですが、改装期間中、経営陣は近くのホテルから勤務しています。
questions.explanationJa: during renovationsは期間限定の一時状況なのでis workingが自然です。

questions.prompt: A visitor asks where Ms. Chen is. “She ------- with a supplier in Meeting Room B at the moment.”

choices.B: is meeting

questions.translationJa: 来訪者がチェンさんの居場所を尋ねます。『現在、会議室Bで仕入先と打ち合わせ中です』。
questions.explanationJa: at the momentの一時的な進行中の会合なのでis meetingです。
questions.focus: 現在進行中の予定行為

questions.prompt: The office usually closes at six, but tonight employees ------- late to finish the launch materials.

choices.B: stay every night tonight

questions.translationJa: オフィスは通常6時閉館ですが、今夜は発売資料を仕上げるため社員が遅くまで残っています。
questions.explanationJa: tonightだけの一時的行動なのでare stayingです。

questions.prompt: The customers have left the lobby. The receptionist says, “They ------- outside anymore.”

choices.B: don't waiting

questions.translationJa: 顧客はロビーを出ました。受付係は『もう外で待ってはいません』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語の進行形否定はaren't waitingです。

questions.prompt: The repair is expected to take three days. While it continues, we ------- a temporary entrance on the east side.

choices.B: uses

questions.translationJa: 修理は3日かかる予定です。その間、東側の仮設入口を使用しています。
questions.explanationJa: 修理期間中だけの一時的利用なのでare usingです。

questions.prompt: The trainer points to the live dashboard. “As you can see, sales ------- steadily this morning.”

choices.B: are increasing

questions.translationJa: 講師はリアルタイムのダッシュボードを指し、『ご覧のとおり、今朝は売上が着実に増えています』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: 今朝という進行中の時間帯で変化が進んでいるためare increasingです。
